newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria names new oil minister in coalition gvt.
newsitem.headline: Algeria names new oil minister in coalition gvt.

text.p: Algeria on Wednesday named an oil expert and former head of cabinet as new energy minister in a three-party coalition government in which the incumbent foreign, finance, and interior ministers are reappointed, an official statement said.
Youssef Yousfi was named energy minister in the place of Amar Makhloufi in the new cabinet headed by Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia who was reappointed nearly two weeks by President Liamine Zeroual.

Islamist-oriented Movement of a Peaceful Society (MPS) and former ruling National Liberation Front (FLN) are represented in the cabinet in which National Democratic Rally (RND), grouping Zeroual's supporters, controls main ministries.
Incumbent Foreign, Interior, Finance and Trade Ministers respectively Ahmed Attaf, Mustapaha Benmansour, Abdelkrim Harchaoui and Bakhti Belaib are reappointed, the statement said.
